body:
## Summary

Reformulates the non-equilibrium cloud-fraction floor and the condensate partition of the truncated-Gaussian SGS closure, and applies review fixes on top.

### Closure changes

- The augmented width `_sgs_augmented_sigma` is written in terms of the subsaturation deficit `max(0, -mu_S)` of cloud-available water. The four provisional floor-release shape parameters are removed.
- `_compute_cloud_fraction` partitions condensate into its equilibrium part `min(q_c, q_c_eq) / sigma_aug` and the non-equilibrium excess `max(0, q_c - q_c_eq) / sqrt(sigma_aug^2 + delta_sub^2)`, so the overcast limit is exact.
- Under `PrognosticEDMFX`, the theta-to-T Jacobian is evaluated at the environment state.
- `conditional_rule` collapses nearly coincident cloud edges `t_a` and `t_e`, whose moments are differences of nearly equal tail integrals.
- Non-equilibrium updraft cloud fraction is evaluated against the updraft vapor subsaturation deficit, consistently in cloud cover and in the radiative inhomogeneity moments.
- New provisional parameter `sgs_cloud_species_constant_timescales` (default 0) selects the constant condensation and sublimation timescales in the 1M cloud-species flux blend.

### Review fixes

- The Picard cloud-fraction iterates receive the configured displacement truncation, matching the final update.
- The updraft cover kernel floors its width at `ϵ_numerics`, evaluates the condensate test with `ifelse`, and guards the in-cloud condensate division.
- `add_cloud_species_diffusionᵥ!` branches once on the timescale switch so each broadcast has a concretely typed relaxation time.
- Docstrings for `SGSQuadratureParameters` and the timescale parameters describe the current parameter set; `NEWS.md` records the removed and added parameters.
- Tests cover the sliver collapse in `conditional_rule`; the updraft cloud-fraction test builds parameters directly.

### Open modeling choice

The updraft cover uses the vapor deficit `q_sat - q_vap`, while the environment floor uses the deficit of cloud-available total water `q_sat - q_cloud`. The two differ only where updraft condensate is comparable to the deficit.

Peeled from ts/swcre-30pct (05dc54e1f) onto main.
title: Improve SGS variance and non-equilibrium cloud-fraction closures
